sections.text:
The Town Square

You arrive in the town square. The evening mist creeps through the cobblestone streets.

Turn to [45](#section-45) to enter the Weeping Willow tavern

Turn to [127](#section-127) to investigate the cemetery

Turn to [234](#section-234) to visit Mayor Hollow's manor
sections.title: The Town Square

sections.text:
The Weeping Willow Tavern

You push open the heavy wooden door of the tavern. The warmth and chatter inside welcome you.

You have won! You found safety and good company.
sections.title: The Weeping Willow Tavern

sections.text:
The Cemetery

The cemetery gates creak ominously as you enter. Ancient tombstones surround you.

Turn to [234](#section-234) to leave quickly
sections.title: The Cemetery

sections.text:
Mayor Hollow's Manor

The grand manor looms before you. Dark windows stare down like empty eyes.

You have died. The manor held unspeakable horrors.
sections.title: Mayor Hollow's Manor
